newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China '96 copper imports estimated at 1 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China '96 copper imports estimated at 1 mln tonnes.

text.p: China imported about one million tonnes of copper in 1996, including concentrate and semi-finished products, Chen Shengnian, vice-president of the China National Non-ferrous Metals Industry Corp, said on Monday.
"Last year we imported a huge amount of copper, about one million tonnes," Chen said after addressing a China non-ferrous metals fair in Hong Kong.
"In recent years, rural and township enterprises and industry are developing very fast so copper demand is much bigger than supply," Chen said.
He did not give a figure for copper imports in 1995 or forecasts for 1997.
The official China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday that China's demand for copper in 1997 would reach 1.2 million tonnes.
